title: Tlhagiso e Nnye Pele ga Moamogedi yo o Gwang
intro: Tsena mo mokgatšheng o mmusi yo o nonofileng le lesomo le legolo ba atamelang mo go one, mme o akanye ka mojanala yo monnye a naya tlhagiso e e bolokang setšhaba sotlhe. Fa morafe o o tshosediwang o fitlha kwa lefelong la tshireletso, kotsi e a feta. Latela dintlha tse di ka go thusang go bona gore ke mang yo o tlhokomologileng yo o ka fa morago ga tlhagiso eo.
clues: Ke gareng ga dibopiwa tse dinnye tse di amanang le bogosi jwa mmusi.
Morafe wa gaetsho o nna mo matlong a bonno mo teng ga mokgatšha, kwa mongwe wa rona a ka bitsang ba bangwe gone.
Re lebane le matshosetsi a a tswang kwa mmusi yoo le masole a a tsamayang le mmusi yoo.
Ke nna yo ke bitsang morafe wa me go tsena mo bonnong jwa bone ke re tlhagisa gore re seka ra thubaganngwa re sa itse.
Mmusi ke Sulayman, mme mofuta wa me o mo gare ga dibopiwa tse di beilweng ka fa tlase ga taolo ya gagwe.
Ke tshoswane ya mokgatšha oo; morago ga tlhagiso ya me, re ne ra tsena mo mafelong a rona a bonno mme ra falola go thubaganngwa go go neng go tla re tshwara re sa lemoge.

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
